"A colosseum echoing with blood and roars—lead your gladiator squad and survive!"

A brutal arena where grotesque, powerful mutants clash. The only way to survive is through absolute strategy and the ultimate build. Take your time during time-limit-free prep phases to align synergies, combine items and augments, and deploy unstoppable units. When auto-combat starts, turn the tide with throwable potions, then build your hall of victory with the Soulstones and MVP units earned from conquering the Colosseum!

1. Relaxed Strategy, No Time Limit

Don't rush through round preparations. Take your time to align synergies, assign items, and build the ultimate formation at your own pace.

2. Endless Growth Combinations: Synergy x Augment x Item

Discover powerful unit synergies, game-changing augments, and stat-boosting items to construct your ultimate overpowered lineup.

3. Forget auto-battlers where you just watch! (Direct Combat Intervention)

Don't let your guard down even after auto-combat begins! Save endangered allies with timely potion throws, and use manual movement to dodge threatful attacks or claim advantageous positions. Experience the thrill of flexible controls that can instantly turn the tide of battle!

4. The Joy of Collecting: Showcase Your Heroes in the Lobby! (MVP System)

Clear stages to claim your top-performing MVP unit as a badge of honor. Collect diverse units and decorate your main lobby with your absolute favorites!

5. Deeper, More Diverse Replayability: Soulstone Upgrades

Permanently upgrade stats and traits with Soulstones earned from battle. Enhancing your traits opens up fresh, creative strategies and builds you couldn't attempt before!

6. Experience the Battlefield Up Close! (Unit-View Camera)

Say goodbye to boring top-down auto-battlers! Switch your camera to your unit's direct perspective and immerse yourself in dynamic, action-packed combat and thrilling skill animations right from the front lines.

Demo planned for August 2026.

A story-driven dark fantasy 2D shooter with four branching endings.

The Blooming Plague is a mysterious disease that slowly transforms people into trees.

When the merchant girl Frelle becomes infected, the young lumberjack Stober sets out to find a legendary remedy hidden deep within a dangerous cave. As the plague spreads and time runs short, the two are drawn into a truth far darker than either of them imagined.

Fight your way through monsters, uncover the secrets behind the plague, and face choices that will shape the fate of both the characters and the world around them.

Features

  • Story-driven dark fantasy adventure

  • Top-down 2D shooter combat

  • Four unique endings based on your choices

  • Multiple routes that reveal different sides of the story

  • A short narrative experience (20–40 minutes per playthrough)

Four Endings, Four Answers

Your journey can lead to four different conclusions:

  • A wish fulfilled together

  • A future carried forward by memory

  • A lonely journey in pursuit of hope

  • A vow to move toward tomorrow

Each ending reveals a different perspective on love, loss, sacrifice, and the meaning of moving forward.

What Will Remain?

This story does not ask which choice was right.

Instead, it asks:

What remains after the choice is made?

Streaming and Video Guidelines

Streaming, gameplay videos, and live broadcasts of this game are welcome.

Both individuals and companies may create and monetize content featuring the game.

We would appreciate it if you could include a link to the Steam store page in the video description whenever possible.

If your content includes major story spoilers, please provide an appropriate spoiler warning.

Discover the answer for yourself.

The game Coma Dreams centers on a battle-hardened Marine, renowned for his courage and daring, who was critically wounded in an ambush during the war, plunging him into a prolonged coma. He was rushed to a specialized medical facility dedicated to soldiers who had fought in those fierce battles. Now, he is tormented by terrifying nightmares;

Your mission is to help him escape this labyrinth of nightmares that feeds on his deepest psychological and mental fears.

Game Features:

  • Gameplay revolves around escaping the nightmare in each stage.

  • Creatures and enemies from the war will pursue you, the soldier.

  • You will face puzzles, hidden keys, and scarce resources such as weapons and ammunition.

  • An atmosphere steeped in psychological horror, featuring unsettling sound design and sudden jump scares.

  • Explore locations from his past, some of which may transform into labyrinths, and encounter characters etched in the soldier's memory.

  • Most bizarrely, the soldier is stalked by a massive, terrifying creature that ambushes him and attempts to kill him, perhaps the embodiment of the nightmare itself; you will discover the truth for yourself.

If you succeed in your mission and overcome the nightmares, the soldier will wake from his coma and return to life, having conquered the harsh circumstances and the hordes of creatures that embodied his deepest, buried fears. This is your role: overcome those fears and save his life.

Combo Break blends the satisfying chaos of a bouncing-ball peg machine with the depth of roguelite deckbuilding. Fill your board with special pegs, combine their effects into powerful synergies, and chase the perfect run where every bounce triggers a cascade. It's a nonstop dopamine rush wrapped in one unpredictable, combo-stacking ride.

DROP PEGS. STACK EFFECTS. BREAK THE COMBO METER.

Your balls bounce on their own — the game is what you build for them to hit. Discover special pegs and slot them onto your board to trigger wild chain reactions:

  • Chain pegs fire lightning between neighbors, hitting multiple pegs from a single bounce.

  • Jackpot pegs charge up and detonate into screen-filling gold payouts.

  • Burn pegs set the board alight, ticking damage over time on everything they touch.

  • Splitter pegs spawn extra balls mid-run to flood the board.

  • Magnet pegs bend nearby balls into your best pegs for guaranteed hits.

  • Crit, Overdrive, Combo Hold, and Gamble pegs push your multiplier higher, faster, and riskier.

Line them up right and one ball sets off a chain of chains — lightning, fire, and jackpots all going off at once as your combo meter blazes white-hot.

BUILD A BOARD THAT'S ALL YOURS

Choose from 8 board formations — arc, grid, ring, spiral, star and more — each changing how your balls flow and where your combos ignite. Expand up to 15 peg sockets and 10 simultaneous balls, then pour points into a shared skill tree that reshapes your whole strategy. Every run is a fresh puzzle: what you draft, where you place it, and how the effects feed each other.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

  • Endless — free-play sandbox. Build forever, chase your biggest board, and see how absurd the payouts can get.

  • Competitive — a survival gauntlet against a rising score clock. Hit each checkpoint before time runs out, climb as far as you can, and post your score to the global leaderboard. Every second counts, and one weak stretch ends the run.

FEATURES

  • 11 special peg effects that stack into explosive synergies

  • 8 board formations that reshape how every run plays

  • Up to 15 sockets and 10 balls on a single board

  • A shared skill tree for run-defining upgrades

  • Endless mode for infinite, no-pressure building

  • Competitive mode with survival checkpoints and a global leaderboard

  • Deep, escalating combo system — the better your board, the louder it gets

"If you become class president, I'll throw you a birthday party."

10-year-old Jimin always has to share. From hand-me-down clothes to the rice straight out of her bowl, nothing feels like it’s truly hers. Invisible between her honor-student older sister and her adorable little brother, she is suddenly presented with a special offer from her mom — if she becomes class president, she can have her very own birthday party. Maybe, just maybe, this could be her chance to finally have a moment that's all her own.

Quirky Classmates

To become class president, she first needs friends. Jimin begins approaching her classmates, each with their own personality, background, and stories they've never shared. From the shy Eunji to the mysterious Daeun, each friend carries their own inner burdens and motives.

Always Stuck in the Middle

At home, Jimin is always in the middle. Between her older sister, who excels at everything and the youngest, who monopolizes all the attention, little is left for Jimin. The hurt and conflict she feels within her family follows her within the classroom walls. Will becoming class president change things? Will throwing a birthday party make anything different?

Lighthearted Humor, Deeply Rooted Emotions

Come to my Party! blends lighthearted humor with themes that hit hard. Live through the eyes of ten-year-old Jimin — experience the bittersweet memories of childhood, the painful indifference of adults, and tangled emotions, often immediately followed by Jimin’s persevering humor and charm. Experience emotional whiplash as you find yourself tearing up from both laughing and crying.

12 Endings, Your Choice

The choices you make in conversations change Jimin's relationships and her day. Whose side to take, what words to say — a single choice that seems trivial can lead to an entirely different ending. Friendships may grow closer or fall apart beyond repair. Whether Jimin can make friends, become class president, and successfully throw her birthday party is in your hands.

Immerse Yourself in 90s South Korea

Before cellphones and the internet, kids connected much differently, and Jimin is no different. Play a variety of mini-games that let you share in Jimin's daily life, from playing ddakji with friends to vandalizing a rival K-Pop group’s posters. Experience a day in the life of a '90s elementary schooler in South Korea up close.

Handcrafted with Heart

Come to My Party! is a deeply personal coming of age story created by a solo developer, featuring entirely hand crafted art and storytelling.

Join Teal, a self-conscious chef, and her best friend Ludo, as they take on a new business venture of running their own restaurant! 

As Teal operates as the restaurant's chef, she will manage orders, prepare food, and get it out in a timely manner, all while building up the courage she once had.

Help Teal regain her courage in this fast-paced environment and become the best chef she was meant to be!

Meet Teal!

Growing up in the Apple Blossom Orphanage, Teal from the start, absolutely loved cooking. And was gifted at it too, making all kinds of dishes at her young age. And when the Orphanage was struggling to pay bills and was on the verge of closure, Teal used her cooking skills to open a stall and sell cucumber sandwiches to pay for it. Earning more than enough money to save the Orphanage and start a new life.

Cut to several years later, and Teal is having a hard time chasing her dreams of becoming a great cook, as no one will give her a chance. This caused the confidence in her cooking that she had as a kid to slowly diminish, with her becoming self-conscious about her food being tasted by anyone. It was around this time that Ludo, Teal's best friend from the Orphanage, approached her with a business venture he had been planning.

A delivery service from home. Teal would take orders and cook meals, essentially becoming a ghost restaurant, while Ludo delivers the orders to the customers. Teal accepts this offer thinking she won't have to face anyone. But in reality, she unaware that Ludo's plan, was the exact opposite..

This Demo will include:

  • Cooking a variety of foods

  • Earning money from completed orders

  • The first shift where you must complete the quota in the allotted time

  • An after-story custom run mode to do a shift with any kind of quota and time limit. (See if you can beat the max difficulty~)

The full game will feature:

  • Cooking a bigger variety of foods

  • Earning money to purchase items and meet deadlines

  • Upgrading zones to further enhance your completion speed

  • Side jobs to earn money and unlock new recipes

  • Custom Shift: Can you beat the max difficulty?~

  • Endless Shift: See how far you can get~

BUILD THE COMIC SHOP YOU'VE ALWAYS DREAMED OF!

Ever dreamed of owning your own comic book store? In Comic Shop Tycoon, that dream becomes reality!

Start with a small neighborhood comic shop and turn it into a thriving destination for comic book fans, collectors, and tabletop gaming enthusiasts. Fill your shelves with comics and collectibles, hunt for valuable back issues, discover new merchandise, and create a store that's uniquely yours.

But running a comic shop isn't just about selling comics. It's about building a business, growing a collection, and making the most of every opportunity that comes through your door.

Your shop. Your collection. Your business.

DISCOVER, COLLECT & SELL BACK ISSUES

Every comic collector knows the thrill of finding something special!

Discover back-issue comics, uncover their values, and build your own collection as you play. Open boxes of older comics, organize your discoveries in collectible binders, and choose which issues deserve a place in your display case.

Will you hold onto your favorite finds, or put them up for sale and turn a profit?

Collecting adds another layer to the experience beyond everyday store management. There's always another comic to discover, another issue to add to your collection, and another opportunity to make a great sale.

EVERY WEDNESDAY IS NEW COMIC BOOK DAY!

The most exciting day of the week for comic fans is also one of the most important days for your business!

Prepare for weekly comic releases by planning your orders, managing your inventory, and getting your shelves ready for the latest issues.

Order too little, and you might miss out on sales. Order too much, and you could tie up valuable money in unsold inventory.

Balancing customer demand, available stock, and your budget is all part of becoming a successful comic shop owner.

RUN YOUR SHOP, YOUR WAY

You're the owner, manager, stock clerk, and cashier. Every decision matters!

  • Order & Stock Merchandise: Purchase inventory, receive deliveries, unpack boxes, and organize your shelves.

  • Set Your Own Prices: Balance profit margins against customer expectations and find a pricing strategy that works for your business.

  • Serve Your Customers: Scan purchases, accept cash and card payments, and keep the checkout line moving.

  • Manage Your Finances: Pay for inventory, watch your spending, and reinvest your earnings into growing the shop.

  • Maintain Your Store: Keep your shop clean, your shelves stocked, and your customers satisfied.

Build a business that runs the way YOU want it to.

MORE THAN JUST COMIC BOOKS!

A great comic shop has something for everyone!

As you gain experience and grow your business, unlock new products and merchandise to expand your selection.

From new comic releases and collectible back issues to action figures, comic supplies, tabletop RPG books, and dice sets, there's plenty to work toward.

Experiment with different product selections, discover what your customers enjoy, and decide how you want to grow your business.

MAKE YOUR STORE TRULY YOURS

Your comic shop should reflect your personality!

Customize and improve your store with new fixtures, shelving, display cases, posters, standees, decorations, and more.

Create a cozy neighborhood shop, a collector's paradise, or a packed comic and gaming destination.

As your business grows, new opportunities open up to improve and expand your space.

The journey from a nearly empty storefront to a fully stocked comic shop is yours to shape.

MEET THE PEOPLE WHO MAKE YOUR SHOP SPECIAL

Every neighborhood comic shop has its regulars, collectors, and memorable visitors.

Customers come looking for different products, with their own shopping preferences and budgets. Some know exactly what they want, while others are happy to browse.

And occasionally, a visitor might have something more interesting in mind than an ordinary purchase!

Keep your customers satisfied, build your store's reputation, and make your shop a place worth coming back to.

KEEP GROWING. KEEP COLLECTING. KEEP PLAYING.

Building a successful comic shop doesn't happen overnight, and there's more to the experience than reaching your first few milestones.

Each day brings new customers, inventory decisions, business challenges, and opportunities to improve your store.

Set your own long-term goals.

Focus on growing a profitable retail business, building up your back-issue collection, expanding into new merchandise, or creating the comic shop of your dreams.

Experiment with different pricing strategies, change your product selection, reorganize your store, and find new ways to improve your business.

With ongoing shop management, collectible discoveries, progression, and customization, there's always something else to work toward.

Whether you enjoy the relaxing routine of running a store or the challenge of building a successful business, Comic Shop Tycoon gives you room to play at your own pace.

YOUR COMIC SHOP STORY STARTS HERE!

From your very first sale to the excitement of uncovering a valuable back issue, every day is another step toward becoming a comic shop tycoon.

Start small. Dream big. Build something special.

How will YOU run your comic shop?

Try the free demo and add Comic Shop Tycoon to your Steam Wishlist to follow its journey into Early Access!

You are not the hero of Westashes. Nobody is.

Company Captain: Westashes is a tactical RPG about leading a mercenary company through a medieval world that does not revolve around you. Factions wage wars you didn't start. Rival companies take the contracts you hesitated on. Bandits starve, grow desperate, and get bolder. The world moves — with you or without you.

Your job: keep your people fed, paid, and alive long enough to become a company worth remembering.

A World That Plays Itself

Every band on the map — knights, bandits, caravans, militias, rival free companies — pursues its own goals under the same rules you play by.

  • Rival companies patrol, hunt contracts, guard caravans and collect tolls — whether you're there or not.

  • Bands negotiate with each other: they demand blood-money, pay for passage, back down, or fight. You can stumble into the aftermath.

  • Bandits turn cowardly when weak and bold when strong. Raiders break camp and vanish when they draw too much attention. Militias garrison their homes at night.

  • Wipe a company off the map and the world won't respawn it — eventually a new one, with a new name and a new captain, rises to fill the vacuum.

Enemy Captains Are Built Exactly Like You

One rule drives the whole game: anything that applies to you applies to them.

  • Every captain has a background, a personality, a motivation and a memory. A Monk captain heals his wounded faster — yours and theirs alike. A Hunter sees farther across the map. So do you.

  • They remember every meeting: the tribute you paid, the parley you broke, the prisoner you executed. Grudges harden into vendettas, and vendettas come looking for you.

  • They win battles, take scars, gain renown and evolve. The enemy you spare today may return next season stronger — and still angry.

Rumors Are Your Quest Log

There is no chosen-one questline. There are taverns, and people talk.

  • "The Crows are starving" isn't flavor text — that band's food actually ran out, and desperate bands do desperate things.

  • Act on a rumor, ignore it, or arrive too late: threads resolve without you, or rot into something worse.

  • Which rumors you chase is who your company becomes.

Brutal Tactical Combat

Turn-based hex battles decided by more than hit points.

  • Positioning, terrain, equipment weight, fatigue and morale all matter. Soldiers panic, rout, and drag others down with them.

  • Enemy leaders fight with real battle plans — ambushes on your route, terror campaigns, personal vendettas — and shout orders that reshape their line mid-fight.

  • Wounds take days to heal. Scars are forever. Death is permanent. Your veterans' scars are your company's true history.

Men Are Expensive. Losing Them Is Worse.

  • Recruit in taverns, where every settlement seats its own crowd — desperate idle hands going cheap, and professionals worth saving up for. Poor villages breed more idle hands than rich cities.

  • Every recruit has a background, a personality and hidden potential. The cheap farmhand may be a late bloomer; the expensive veteran arrives already scarred.

  • His hiring price you pay once. His wage bites at every single dawn — and your captain draws none, because the company is his.

  • Rival companies drink in the same taverns. The man you spent a week saving up for may already be marching under someone else's banner.

Honor Is Not Fame

Reputation runs on two axes: what you're known for, and how loudly.

  • Slaughter caravans and knights will hunt you while outlaws step aside. Guard the roads and lords pay premium — while bandits mark you as a threat.

  • Grow infamous enough and a price lands on your head. Other companies will gladly take that contract.

  • Earn an ally instead and they'll share intel, split contract rewards — and their deserters may ask to join your banner.

The Road Remembers Too

The land between battles is not empty.

  • Trade a scar to the witch. Share a meal with the hermit. Read the warning left beside the hanged man.

  • Watchtowers are held by whoever takes them — clear one out, or walk into one held against you. Mountain passes hide ambushes with real tactical teeth.

  • When the traveling fair arrives, even enemies drink under the same truce. Breaking it has a price.

Emergent Stories

None of this is scripted. In one campaign, a captain whose toll we refused at a mountain pass nursed the grudge for a month, rebuilt his warband, and caught us in that same pass — with the high ground. Three veterans didn't come home. Nobody wrote that story. It just happened, and the company chronicle kept the receipt.

If this sounds like your kind of game, wishlist it — for a solo dev it genuinely moves the needle. And come argue about balance in the Discord; Early Access is going to be built on those arguments.

Module Madness is a top-down bullet-hell roguelite about attrition. Every module you scavenge has a durability. Spend it, and the module is gone for good. Kit out your ship from wrecks and supply drops, burn through it in combat, and take whatever survives into the next solar system. Pick a ship, drop in, fight until you die.

Our ship has one cannon, and that is it. Every ability, every bonus sits in the modules you pick up along the way. What you are carrying decides how you play, and no two runs hand you the same set — over 25 modules across five rarity tiers, and more than 150,000 unique combinations of them.

Active modules you trigger yourself: bombs, lasers, shields, dashes. A laser that sweeps in a rotating arc. A dash that cuts through whatever it passes. A minefield you leave behind you. A shield that fires itself when things get tight. Passive modules work quietly in the background, raising values like damage, speed or health, or adding projectiles to your front, sides and rear. How many of each fit on board depends on the ship.

Every use wears a module down, and passive modules wear out in the background too. Sooner or later they break, and there is nowhere to repair them. The slot sits empty and you move on. So every trigger pull is a decision. Spend the shield now, or hold it for the boss. Burn the legendary module now or save it for later. You are not building toward the perfect loadout, you are working with whatever still fires.

Downed enemies leave containers behind. Open one and it offers you a choice of modules: choose well. Larger containers hold more loot. Whatever you leave behind, you will not see again. Supply drops sit out in the open for anyone willing to go and get them. And when a trader turns up, you can buy, sell and reroll the stock — invest enough and the restricted goods come out from under the counter.

Before every section you see what is waiting: enemy types, threat level, expected loot. Safe and lean, or dangerous and worth it.

Five enemy types across three tiers each. Hunters that run you down, swarm bots that crowd you out, pattern shooters that spray you down, reflector tanks that throw your own shots back at you. Fights happen in sealed arenas — no running away, no endless kiting, just you, and whatever space you carve out. Every solar system ends with a multi-phase boss.

No time limit. Endless runs. One solar system follows the next, each harder than the last. The run ends when you die. Then the numbers come up: how deep you got, how long you lasted, what you killed, what you banked. Above them sits your best run so far. That is the one you are actually up against.

  • Top-down bullet-hell roguelite built around attrition

  • Modules with durability — using them spends them, and broken means gone

  • 25+ active and passive modules, five rarity tiers, 150,000+ unique combinations

  • Five enemy types in three tiers, plus scaling multi-phase bosses

  • Sealed arenas: no escape

  • Pick your own route with enemy types, threat level and loot shown up front

  • Three unique ships with different Stats

  • Endless runs until you die

  • Mouse and keyboard or controller, Xbox Gamepad Support

Conquest of Empires 3 builds a strategy-first world of multi-civilization warfare, where cunning is the only passport, and every player can rely on their intellect to carve out their own empire in an epic sandbox.

The game integrates the core features of four major civilizations—China, Rome, Egypt, and Persia—allowing players to recruit legendary generals from each civilization and assemble their own all-star lineup. From Macedonian phalanx charges to surprise attacks by steam airships, hundreds of unit types and formations can be freely combined, leveraging realistic terrain to craft personalized tactics and easily achieve victory against superior foes.

Alliance cooperation is key to triumph. Plan multi-pronged siege strategies with allies, exploit mountains and rivers, and create endlessly shifting battle scenarios. The game features an intelligent command system that supports scheduled marches and 24/7 automated combat—troops advance automatically, resources are collected autonomously, allowing players to dominate the battlefield without exhausting grind.

The game adheres to the principle of fair, privilege-free competition: all players start on an equal footing, and victory depends solely on tactical coordination and on-the-spot command. A wealth of free premium currency channels is fully accessible, with steady rewards from main quests, world exploration, and conquests of famous cities. In the first season alone, over 10,000 premium currency tokens are available to fuel your growth.

Step into this magnificent theater of war, let strategy decide the outcome, and let strength build your legacy. Come to Conquest of Empires 3 and write your own civilization's epic!

Contrabandism Simulator is a simulation game set in a port that lives at night, where the moral boundaries of trade are unclear.
Every product has a story, every customer has an intention, and every night has its own unique risk.

The goal of the game is simple: make profit and survive.
However, nothing in the port is as simple as it seems.

Night begins, trade intensifies

The game is mainly played at night. As the port sinks into darkness, customers arrive one by one at your shop.
Some want to sell goods, others come to buy from your shelves.
It is up to the player to decide who is honest and who is opportunistic.

Every negotiation is a risk.
The wrong price, the wrong customer, or the wrong product can lead to a loss-filled night.

Daytime: preparation and strategy

When the sun rises, the port becomes calm.
This time is used to organize the shop, place products on shelves, and plan for the next night.

Daytime preparations determine whether you survive the night.

Containers, auctions, and uncertainty

Products are not only obtained from customers.

Auctions offer rare and valuable items, but carry high risk.

Containers purchased from the container dealer contain random goods depending on their type and rarity. Every opening is a surprise.

The trader sells a limited and random selection of goods. Prices are often unreliable.

The system constantly leaves the player with one question:
“Is this really a good opportunity, or an expensive mistake?”

Atmosphere and emotion

The game takes place in a gloomy port environment.
Foggy docks, dim lights, and ambient sounds create a tense atmosphere that keeps the player alert.

Contrabandism Simulator is not just a trading game; it is an experience built on waiting, suspicion, and risk-taking.

No one in this port is completely innocent. What matters is whether you are still standing when morning comes.

BUILD A TRANSPORT COMPANY, ONE DECISION AT A TIME

Start with a single van and grow into a freight network that covers the whole map. You choose which contracts to take, which trucks to buy, and which regions to open. The clock runs while you decide, and pauses whenever you need to think.

CHOOSE WHICH CONTRACTS TO TAKE

A new set of contracts appears on the board every 6 hours. Each one shows what it pays, what it carries, how far it goes, and how long the trip could take: a range from the fastest route to the cheapest.

You have a limited number of trucks and a limited number of contract slots, so taking one job means turning down another.

CHAIN JOBS ONTO ONE TRUCK

Every empty run to the next pickup costs fuel and earns nothing. Pick a second job that loads where the first one drops off, then a third — up to three jobs on one truck, run back to back, with no empty driving in between.

You set the order. Every job's deadline keeps running while the jobs ahead of it are driving, so the wrong order makes the last one late. The map draws the whole run and marks each point where one job's drop-off is the next one's pickup.

THE MARKET AND THE ROADS CHANGE

Rates for a type of cargo can rise for a day or two, or fall. Now and then one very large job appears on the board. Each change is announced when it starts, marked on the offers it affects, and counts down in the top bar until it ends.

Roads change too. An accident makes one stretch slower; a closure shuts it completely. New routes go around it, but a truck already on its way has to drive through it.

BUY THE TRUCKS THE WORK NEEDS

There are eight kinds of trucks to buy, across six classes, and eleven types of cargo. Refrigerated cargo needs a reefer, liquids need a tanker, and oversized loads need a Heavy Haul truck.

A bigger truck costs more to run, and it still cannot take a job your licenses do not cover.

LICENSES UNLOCK NEW CARGO

Most licenses need the right trucks, a big enough company and enough reputation. Meet the requirements, pay the fee, and new work starts appearing on the board.

Licenses can also be lost. Sell the last truck that qualified you for one and it goes under review, then gets suspended: you can't take new jobs for that cargo until you re-certify.

BUILD A NETWORK ACROSS A GROWING WORLD

From Tier 3 you can send freight through hubs instead of driving every load direct. Small trucks feed a hub, larger trucks run between hubs. Each hub only clears so much cargo at a time, and overloading one backs up everything behind it.

New regions open as the company grows, each with its own cargo and its own roads. There are five company tiers, from a local courier to an operator working in every region.

AUTOMATE THE ROUTINE

From Tier 4 you can write standing orders: rules that accept contracts matching conditions you set, and assign a truck to them without asking you.

Automation charges a commission, always takes the Balanced route and never chains jobs, so dispatching by hand still pays better on any lane you watch yourself. Jobs a rule holds back wait at the top of the Spot Market for your decision.

At a glance

  • Real-time management — pause whenever you need to plan

  • Grow from a single van into a freight network across the whole map

  • Chain up to three jobs onto one truck, with no empty driving between them

  • Eight trucks and eleven types of cargo, each with its own rules

  • Licenses that unlock new cargo — and can be suspended if you slip

  • Market and road events — rates that rise and fall, accidents, closures

  • Build hub networks — avoid bottlenecks

  • Expand into new regions

  • Five company tiers

  • Optional dispatch automation for routine work

  • Reputation that unlocks better contracts

  • Single-player · Sandbox

Build a factory that gets increasingly automated. The output of the factory is used to create and upgrade a planet-splitting drill that consumes massive amounts of energy. Craft Combat Units and watch them fight for control over enemy controlled sites like Power Plants, design a system that wins the war against a Runaway Artificial Superintelligence, all via logistics.

Start small with manual mining and grow your factory to automate everything

The procedurally generated sandbox worlds allow you to create your own factory layout in any way imaginable.

Move units to enemy sites via conveyors and capture them with auto-battle mechanics.

Use the Core Splitter Drill to drill down into the world, upgrade it to progress faster and get more rewards.

About

Core splitter is made by a solo indie developer including music, art, assets, programming and story. The game takes inspiration from Factorio and Satisfactory which are some of my favorite all time games. While also putting a different spin on some mechanics.

Welcome to the future. Cyberspace is now home to the Core, a network of digital spherical prisons designed to keep those within safely contained. You are a CoreRunner, one of the few who can fight a path to freedom. Skate, slash, and shoot your way to freedom in neon-drenched, high-speed battles across retrowave landscapes.

Defeat the Core security systems and define your own combat style, taking down foes at range with digital gunfire, getting in close and personal with the deadly katanas, or trapping them within your light trail until they crash and dissipate.  Every motion is a weapon. Every second counts.

CARVE YOUR PATH

Carve your path through waves of digital guardians while the environment itself turns against you. Every level pulses with electric intensity, every firefight becomes a test of agility and timing. The Core wants to keep you. Only a CoreRunner can lead the way out.

ESCALATING DANGER

The closer you get to freedom, the more guardians will try to stop you from escaping the Core. Fight turrets, drones, homing missiles, and hostile patrols in ever more intense battles.

PRECISION IN MOTION

Built for mastery. Tight responsive controls keep every movement sharp and fast,  even in the most challenging of arenas. Flow between dodging, aiming, and slashing without missing a beat.

BURN THE NEON, BREAK THE BEAT

Ride the rhythm of the Core. Every arena and gameplay experience is synchronized with the pulsating synthwave beat in your escape from digital captivity.

Corefall is an idle dungeon RPG. You build a team of heroes, gear them up, set up their skill trees, and send them into dungeons and raids that they fight through on their own. Most of your time goes into picking the right heroes, equipping them, and tuning their builds.

8 Man Raids!

There are 7 raids at the endgame, and they take a full team of 8 heroes instead of the usual party. Each one has its own boss and its own legendary drops. They're tuned to be hard, so you'll need good gear and decent builds to clear them.

22 Heroes, Manage Your Team!

You have a roster of different hero classes to choose from — tanks, healers, and damage dealers. You pick who goes on each run, how they're geared, and how their skill trees are set up. You can swap heroes between runs and check the combat meter to see who's doing the most work.

Loot That Matters!

Loot drops while your team fights, ranging from common gear up to legendaries. It goes into a shared stash, and you equip it onto whichever hero needs it. Weapons are locked to their class, but armor, capes, rings, and amulets can go on any hero. There's also a Collection Log that tracks the signature drops from each dungeon and raid.

Dungeons and Boss Fights!

There are 25 dungeons, each with 3 floors and a boss at the end that drops its signature loot. They range from the Mushroom Den early on to the Geode Sanctum and the Spire Dungeons near the end. You can raise the difficulty as your team gets stronger, and there's an Endless mode that keeps going until your team can't handle it anymore.

Skill Tree!

Each hero has its own passive skill tree. You earn a point per level and spend it on stat nodes, Notables, and Keystones. You can build the same hero a few different ways depending on which path you take — more crit, more survivability, crowd control, and so on.

The Endgame Is Endless!

Built to Respect Your Time!

Corefall plays itself when you want it to and rewards deep engagement when you don't. Send a run and check back later, or sit down and min-max for hours. The choice is always yours.

Features

  • Idle auto-combat rendered in full 3D

  • 25+ dungeons and multiple epic raids

  • 22 playable heroes across tank, healer, and DPS roles

  • Deep gear system with tiers, rarities, and a Collection Log

  • 185-node skill tree with game-changing keystones

  • Endless endgame with infinitely scaling difficulty

  • Global leaderboards: Gear Score, Total Level, Dungeons Cleared, Top Hero per class, and Endless depth

Descend. Gear up. Go deeper.

I can't wait to release this game, it is honestly super fun!

FPS GUNPLAY MEETS TOWER DEFENSE, WITH A TOUCH OF ROGUE-LIKE FLAVOUR

Corpo Dog is a fast-paced single-player action/strategy hybrid that blends high-octane FPS combat with tactical tower defense, set against the neon-drenched backdrop of a cyberpunk megacity. Run and gun with a deadly personal arsenal, dynamically deploy automated defense turrets, and build out high-tech cybernetic upgrades on the fly as you battle waves of enemies driven mad by Cyberrot. Completing outsourced jobs for local megacorps is your only ticket to becoming a full-time employee.

KEY FEATURES

  • Hybrid Combat System: Seamlessly swap between fast-paced personal gunplay and real-time defensive turret deployment. Demo provides 10 different weapons in several categories.

     

  • Rogue-like Progression: Earn credits in combat to upgrade your Brain-chip subscription level. Draft randomized cybernetic augmentations and weapon mods to pivot your tactical strategy on the fly. Demo provides 14 different power-ups.

     

  • Stages & Maps: 10 distinct stages for each run, and each stage has a map pool consisting of at least 2 maps. All maps are hand-crafted and carefully designed to provide fun and challenges. Demo provides 2 stages, and each with 2 maps.

       

  • Modular Turret Arsenal: Spend hard-earned credits to unlock and upgrade a versatile array of defenses—from rapid-fire laser turrets and plasma cannons to heavy missile arrays. Every turret features three tiers, transforming basic emplacements into powerhouses. Demo provides 4 types of turrets.

     

  • Tactical Wave Defence: Defend critical data terminals against relentless waves of street thugs, bio-androids, rogue drones, and heavily armed corporate security forces—some packing hardened armor or devastating special abilities.

     

  • Pure Arcade Action: Snappy movement, instant upgrades, tactical deployment, and high-intensity wave survival deliver immediate, pulse-pounding action from the second you spawn in.

     

  • Story: Bits and pieces in tips and terminal logs. All in-game text was written while the developer was slacking off—read it if you want, or just ignore it and keep shooting! If time permits and the developer isn't too overworked, there's gonna be updates.

Play as Elina, a receptionist at an Adventurers’ Guild in the Kingdom. Review quest documents, issue rewards, and sometimes face illicit dealings in a guild receptionist simulation.

To pay for your sick sister’s medicine, will you work honestly—or turn to bribery, embezzlement, and other forms of corruption? Handle your daily workload, manage your money, and survive life at the Guild.

During the day, the player works at the guild reception, processing applications by verifying documents and certificates. After the work, the day's earnings are tallied, and the money is used to cover living expenses and the cost of medicine for the player's younger sister.

Overview

A receptionist’s duties are many and varied.

Process applications from aspiring adventurers. Appraise materials brought in for sale. Review the results of completed quests...

Examine application forms, identification papers, and certificates, and look for inconsistencies.

Are the details correct? Is the certificate genuine? Did this adventurer really complete the quest?

Approve the application, send it back, or accept a bribe and look the other way. Every decision you make affects both your livelihood and your standing in town.

Like Papers, Please, you will compare documents and search for discrepancies—but there is more at stake than simply choosing the correct answer.

Handle your work properly and you can protect your reputation, but honest wages alone may not be enough. Turn to corruption and earning money for your sister’s medicine becomes easier—but suspicion will grow, increasing the risk of inspections and arrest.

Manage your reputation, suspicion, cash on hand, and the cost of your sister’s medicine as you make it through each day.

If things become too dangerous, you can abandon the town and skip town in the night.

Will you stay or run? How far are you willing to go?

Your decisions will lead Elina’s story toward multiple possible endings.

Features

・Document-checking gameplay built around forms, identification papers, and certificates

・Spot legitimate rewards, fraudulent claims, and forged documents

・Risky money-making through bribery, falsification, and embezzlement

・Risk management involving reputation, suspicion, and cash on hand

・Manage your finances to pay for your sick sister’s medicine

・Multiple endings, including dismissal, arrest, and escape from the Kingdom

・A serious story set in a royal Adventurers’ Guild

As a Guild Receptionist, can you play by the rules?

Can you save your sister by working honestly?

About the Game

In Corrupted Worlds, you become the last hope of all life in the Universe. During your journey, you will embody an advanced alien probe, occupied by a fanatical AI on a holy mission. If you are to have any hope of defeating the cosmic parasite known as Scourge, you must adhere to the one true path:

Decode strange artifacts, salvage uncorrupted DNA and confront the horrors of a Scourge infestation. Explore a decaying planetary system on the brink of extinction. Navigate nightmarish biomechanical labyrinths, uncover the fate of a vanished Terran civilization and outrun the relentless growth of a giant sun.

You can look forward to:

🌑 Survival-driven gameplay – Traverse hostile, ever-shifting planets. Each unique, with its own set of dangers. One wrong move can cost you your life. Adapt or perish.

🔍 Conquering puzzles and dungeons – Show that you have your wits about you. Solve puzzles and overcome insidious dungeons, set up by the ever-scheming Scourge. 

🧬 Uncovering mysterious artifacts – Collect genetic samples and remnants of cultural artifacts. Piece together the historical heritage of Terrans.

🚀 Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator

Run your own bakery… in space.

Bake sweet treats, prepare coffee, keep your shelves stocked, and stay on top of a growing stream of customer orders.

As your bakery gets busier, organize your workflow, put your robot helpers to work, and keep everything running smoothly — alone or with friends.

🍩 BAKE & BREW

Use your machines to prepare desserts and fresh coffee for your customers.

Keep production moving, prepare what you need ahead of time, and make sure you’re ready when new orders arrive.

🍰 STOCK, SERVE & KEEP UP

A prepared bakery is a successful bakery.

Keep your display stocked, respond to incoming orders, and serve customers before things start piling up.

As the bakery gets busier, balancing preparation and speed becomes increasingly important.

🤖 PUT YOUR ROBOTS TO WORK

You don’t have to run the bakery alone.

Use different robot helpers to support your daily workflow and take some of the pressure off as your business grows.

Decide where their help matters most and keep your bakery operating efficiently.

🪐 BUILD A BAKERY OF YOUR OWN

Turn your small space bakery into a place that feels like yours.

Expand your setup, unlock new possibilities, and customize your bakery with decorations as you progress.

🐾 CARE FOR YOUR FURRY FRIEND

Pet your cat, keep its food and water bowls filled, and watch it find a cozy spot around your bakery.

Make time for your little companion between orders and strengthen your bond. Once your bond grows strong enough, your cat boosts the tips your customers leave.

🌌 A BAKERY IN SPACE

Your bakery sits on a floating platform surrounded by a colorful sci-fi world.

Life in space comes with unexpected moments. When rain rolls in, activate your bakery’s protective shield and keep business going.

Bake, serve, manage your crew, and build your business in a lighthearted space setting filled with unusual customers.

👥 PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS

Run the bakery by yourself or team up with up to 4 players.

Split the work, manage different parts of the bakery, and work together when the orders start stacking up.

🎯 FEATURES

  • Bake desserts using production machines

  • Prepare and serve coffee

  • Keep your displays stocked and manage incoming orders

  • Manage different robot helpers

  • Customize and develop your bakery

  • Care for your cat and build a strong bond to boost customer tips

  • Activate your bakery’s protective shield when rain arrives

  • Handle increasingly busy shifts

  • Play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players

  • Explore a colorful stylized sci-fi setting

Cosmo Corgis

Gather resources, get your upgrades, rescue corgis, and hop on your ship from planet to planet on the way home. Cosmo Corgis is a cozy desktop companion idler with ten planets, ten stranded corgis, and six personalities to keep you company while you work.

This is my first game release on Steam and I really hope you enjoy it!

Rescue the Corgi

Collect a corgi from each planet and make space for them on the ship that Scout crashed... again. Who gave Scout the astronaut his license? No action is needed from you. Scout handles the rescuing automatically.

Meet the Corgis


Ten rescued corgis, six personalities, and a colored space suit and backpack for each personality:

  • Mechanic, in yellow, welds beside the rocket with sparks and a little "Bzzzz."
  • Security, in blue, chases visiting wildlife with an oversized megaphone and amplified borks.
  • Mining, in amber, gathers resources with a backpack laser.
  • Lazy, in purple, unfolds a hover bed from its backpack and gets comfortable.
  • Chaos, in red, does zoomies and chases balls from its backpack launcher.
  • Clingy, in green, follows Scout and helps carry resources.

Your crew grows with every rescue. They take turns doing their thing, with occasional close-ups so you can enjoy the little moments.

Gather Resources

Scout gathers the resources needed to repair his ship and reach the next planet. This is an idler, so he does the hard work while you get on with yours—or sit back and watch him and the corgis entertain you.

Upgrade

Upgrade your axe to gather more wood, your pickaxe to gather more ore, and work toward Scout's laser rifle. Give his trailing storage cart more room so he can stay out longer, and expand the base storage to hold the haul. The default autopilot handles upgrades for you, or you can take charge of what to improve next.

Repair Your Ship


Scout's ship is what gets him from planet to planet. However, Scout is a terrible pilot and crash lands on each planet. He must build good safety systems because he comes out unscathed every time. Scout has to make more room for the corgi that you rescue on that planet, so it needed to come apart anyway. Right?

Fly to the Next Planet

Once Scout's ship is in tip top shape, it's time to crash into the next planet! Scout and his corgi companions blast off into the cosmos in search of the next planet on their way home, faceplant the rocket and start the process all over again!

Bring All of the Corgis Home

All of these corgis need some place to stay. Planet 10 brings all ten rescued corgis together for a reunion. Keep them company for as long as you like, or choose to restart the journey.

Desktop Companion

The game plays at the bottom of your desktop or in either bottom corner with a transparent background. Keep Scout and his gang in front of your other apps, or bring your windows forward and get back to work. Enjoy the peaceful music and the corgis barking as they play, or turn either off. Your choice.

Couch Pirates! is an easy to play party game that allows anyone to join using their gamepad or phone. Invite your friends over for an easy flexible gaming experience! Connect your phones to the local Wi-Fi and start playing!

The game is played using a joystick and only one button.

You learn to play the game as you go!

Chose among four mini-games to battle it out on one desert island! Pick up items that fall from the sky, and use them to conquer the enemy team, or all other players when in free-for-all mode. The games are straight forward and easy to learn. Shuffle the teams at a press of a button whenever you feel like mixing things up.

There is no limit to the number of players that can play at once, but players share one screen.

Couch Pirates! is best enjoyed from the couch in front of a big screen.

The ultimate party game!

The game is endless, and people may join and leave as they please throughout the evening, just keep the game rolling. There is no restriction on the amount of players that can play, but at around 10 players it may start to get a bit crazy.

Settings allows you to auto-balance teams (when odd-numbered) with additional AI-players (bots), which also allows you to play the game solo. You may also add more bots to let them play each other for a watching/betting/rooting kind of experience. No need to lift a finger.

At Manovian, we praise couch gaming and encourages meeting in person with friends, family and colleagues to enjoy a quick and simple gaming experience.

Your computer is infected. Buddy, a tiny calculator, is going in after the viruses.

Step into the Wallpaper Kingdom, an old adventure program where desktop tools have become strange places. The printer is a paper-covered meadow. The control panel is a land of giant switches. KERNEL waits at Castle My Computer, with Buddy's friends locked up along the road.

Same answer. Different attack.

In these turn-based fights, how you answer matters. A plain number makes Buddy strike and brace against the enemy's next attack. An equivalent equation delivers a power strike, but gives up that protection.

Need 25? Type 25 to brace, or try 5 × 5 for a harder hit. Read the enemy's next move and decide when to play safe and when to build something bigger. The question clock keeps the pressure on.

The viruses play dirty

Stolen digits. Jammed keys. A runaway equals button. Pop-ups that land on your keypad while the clock keeps ticking. Close the warnings before you answer, or the ones left open can hurt Buddy.

Your CHAOS meter fills as you answer. Spend it on a CHAOS.EXE spin for a helpful or risky surprise.

Choose your road

Follow the signposts through nine zones, each with its own boss. Choose between fights, recharge stations, campfires, treasure, mysteries, math gates and the Shareware Stall. Collect items and Quick Programs to change what your next fight looks like.

Boss victories repair broken desktop programs and free friends. There are nine friends to rescue, each with five ranks of abilities. Bring up to three along the road and let them help in battle.

A setback is another reason to return

An empty battery ends the run, but you keep freed friends, restored programs, cosmetics, records and earned scrap. Spend scrap on permanent Repair Bench upgrades before trying again. A defeated Buddy can also leave a travelling friend held hostage: find the cage on a later run to bring them back.

Beat KERNEL to finish the nine-zone journey, then choose whether to keep walking into Overtime for a distance record.

Choose Easy, Normal or Brainy math. Play with keyboard and mouse, and use the screen-shake and reduced-motion settings to adjust the presentation.

Six children have been kidnapped and taken into the dark woods.

Beyond the last lantern lies a forest the community has feared for generations. Strange creatures move between the trees, armed outlaws stalk the forgotten paths, and somewhere in the darkness, a hidden cult prepares to complete its ritual.

You must choose a leader, assemble an expedition, select the equipment they will carry, and enter the forest before it is too late.

Courage and Faith: Into the Dark Woods is a text-based party RPG that combines atmospheric storytelling, expedition management, and tactical turn-based combat. Every companion brings a distinct personality, unique strengths, and different ways of confronting danger.

Build Your Expedition

Speak with potential recruits and decide who deserves a place in your party. Hunters, scholars, soldiers, mystics, and other members of the community each offer different advantages.

Your choices determine who will stand beside you when the expedition reaches the darkest parts of the forest.

Prepare Before Entering the Woods

Choose your equipment carefully. Weapons, defensive tools, medical supplies, and specialized items can unlock different actions and determine whether the expedition survives its next encounter.

You cannot bring everything. Every preparation requires a sacrifice.

Fight as a Party

During combat, every living expedition member can perform one of several actions based on their abilities and equipment. Attack the enemy, protect a wounded companion, strengthen the group, or use a valuable item at the right moment.

But fear is as dangerous as any creature.

As tension rises, the number of actions available to the expedition decreases. A missed attack, a poor decision, or the wrong order of actions can turn a controlled battle into panic.

A Journey That Reacts to Your Actions

Dynamic narration describes the consequences of your decisions, victories, failures, wounds, and sacrifices.

The central journey may be set, but the people who undertake it — and what happens to them along the way — depend on how you lead.

Features

  • A dark, atmospheric single-player adventure

  • A party of characters with distinct personalities and advantages

  • Tactical turn-based battles with an escalating tension system

  • Meaningful equipment and expedition preparation

  • Reactive narration shaped by your actions and combat results

  • Supernatural creatures, dangerous outlaws, and a mysterious cult

  • A focused story about courage, responsibility, and faith in the face of darkness

The expedition is the children's only hope of returning home.

Lead the expedition into the dark woods — and bring them back.

Play Hearts. Break the rules. Expose the truth.

Court of Hearts: Masquerade Trials transforms classic Hearts into a Victorian gothic roguelike filled with powerful combinations, supernatural rule changes, masked witnesses, and courtroom deception.

Pass dangerous cards, create voids in your hand, force penalties onto your rivals, and decide whether to avoid the Queen of Spades or turn her into your greatest weapon. Build around Artifacts, enhanced cards, and scoring Tactics that reward clever passing, precise plays, and calculated risks.

The Early Access version includes complete Solo Runs, AI opponents, public matchmaking, private Steam friend lobbies, and private online co-op against AI. The Masquerade Trials story campaign is planned for version 1.0.

Build a Powerful Run

In Solo Run, survive increasingly dangerous Hearts rounds while assembling a build that changes how every hand is played.

Generate Power by sending penalty cards to your opponents. Create voids through strategic passing, trigger specialized Tactics, enhance individual cards, and combine Artifacts into powerful scoring chains.

Build around strategies such as:

  • Disposing of dangerous cards while void in a suit

  • Passing marked cards and tracking their recipients

  • Turning the Queen of Spades into a scoring weapon

  • Chaining precise plays into large Power bonuses

  • Protecting your limited Composure

  • Risking everything on a declared Moonshot

Visit shops between rounds, improve your Tactics, enhance important cards, restore Composure, and prepare for Elite encounters and Boss Rules that alter the foundations of Hearts.

Unlock 40+ Artifacts

Artifacts provide build-defining effects that change how you pass cards, create voids, generate Power, protect Composure, and interact with penalty cards.

Some strengthen passed cards, reward specialized Tactics, improve enhanced cards, or amplify the Queen of Spades. Others enable unusual combinations that can completely reshape your strategy.

Earn Profile XP through Solo Runs and multiplayer matches. Increase your Profile Level, open gameplay-earned Artifact Packs, and permanently unlock new Artifacts for future runs.

Artifact Packs are earned through play and provide no paid competitive advantage.

Play Hearts Your Way

Solo Run

Take on complete roguelite runs featuring shops, upgrades, Elite encounters, Boss Rules, limited Composure, and persistent progression.

Classic Hearts

Play traditional Hearts against AI opponents, enter public online matchmaking, or create a private lobby with Steam friends.

Court of Hearts

Play a rule-breaking version of Hearts featuring Artifacts, enhanced cards, Tactics, and gameplay modifiers that change how each match unfolds.

Compete through online matchmaking or create a private lobby with friends.

Private Online Co-op

Invite a Steam friend to a private lobby and work together against two AI opponents.

Masquerade Trials: Planned for Version 1.0

The Masquerade Trials story campaign is planned for version 1.0 and is not included in the initial Early Access release.

The full campaign will combine Hearts with a Victorian gothic mystery involving masked witnesses, evidence, testimony, supernatural rule changes, and courtroom deduction.

Use Trial Effects to uncover hidden details, preserve evidence, challenge suspicious testimony, and strengthen your case against each witness.

Early Access focuses on the complete Hearts roguelite, progression, AI, multiplayer, and private co-op modes described above.

Features

  • Tactical Hearts gameplay built around passing, void creation, penalty routing, and Shooting the Moon

  • Complete solo roguelite runs with shops, upgrades, Elite encounters, and Boss Rules

  • 40+ unlockable Artifacts with build-defining effects

  • Card Enhancements, Tactic upgrades, and powerful build combinations

  • Persistent Profile Levels and gameplay-earned Artifact Packs

  • Classic Hearts against AI or online players

  • Rule-breaking online multiplayer Hearts

  • Public matchmaking and private Steam friend lobbies

  • Private online co-op against AI opponents

  • Steam friend invitations

  • Achievements, statistics, leaderboards, and Steam Cloud support

  • Mouse, keyboard, controller, and Steam Deck support

  • Accessibility options
