A covenant is more than a stronghold. It is a community, a legacy, and a story that unfolds across generations.

Covenantum is a seasonal covenant-management strategy game inspired by Ars Magica, a tabletop role-playing game about powerful magi building communities, pursuing magical knowledge, and navigating the politics and dangers of a mythic medieval Europe. Lead a fledgling community of Magi, Companions and Grogs through decades of magical research, political intrigue, supernatural mysteries and changing relationships.

Every season, decide how your people spend their time. Study ancient texts, invent spells, improve laboratories, secure food and income, gather intelligence, investigate rumours, explore dangerous places or deal with threats closer to home.

BUILD YOUR COVENANT

Manage food, finances, vis, morale, loyalty, security, laboratories, libraries, alliances and other long-term assets as your covenant grows from uncertain beginnings into a major power.

CREATE A SAGA THAT REMEMBERS

Rumours become story leads. Rivals remember grievances. Characters remember support and neglect. Decisions can create new opportunities, stronger relationships, lasting enemies or consequences that return years later.

DEVELOP YOUR CHARACTERS

Magi pursue magical research, apprentices, familiars and Hermetic ambitions. Companions investigate, negotiate and follow personal goals. Grogs keep the covenant fed, defended and functioning through practical skill and specialist work.

NAVIGATE THE ORDER OF HERMES

Build relationships with other covenants, gather intelligence, trade, form alliances and deal with Tribunal politics. Different regions bring their own pressures, rivalries and opportunities.

EXPLORE MYTHIC EUROPE

Discover lost ruins, hidden regios, vis sources, faerie bargains, supernatural threats and forgotten knowledge. Some discoveries become valuable assets. Others become problems that refuse to stay buried.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

RAW Mode offers the deeper simulation, with additional Hermetic obligations, House progression, Tribunal systems, Twilight and stricter long-term planning.  Strongly aligned with the Ars Magica rules system.

Story Mode keeps the same covenant-management foundation while simplifying some procedural systems so the focus remains on characters, events and the evolving saga.

FEATURES

  • Seasonal covenant-management gameplay

  • Magi, Companions and Grogs with distinct roles

  • Character motivations and long-term relationships

  • Persistent story leads, rivalries and consequences

  • Laboratory work, spells, apprentices and familiars

  • Tribunal politics, diplomacy and rival covenants

  • Adventures and supernatural exploration

  • Long-term saga ambitions and covenant development

  • Two distinct game modes: RAW and Story

Every season costs time. Every decision leaves a memory. Every covenant tells a different story.  What will yours be?

Cozy Airways is an airline tycoon with the stress taken out. Open routes across a storybook world, look after passengers who each turn up with a little story, and grow a single puddle-jumper into an airline that circles the globe, with your co-pilot Sky beside you the whole way. Prefer to just build? Focus Mode keeps it to routes, fleet, and hubs.

Start with one plane and one city. Open a route, set the fare, and watch your little aircraft trace its way across the world. Every city you connect brings more travelers into the network, and routes that stay open build up regulars who keep coming back. Grow from a single home hub into a network that spans continents (New York to Paris, Seoul to Cairo, Auckland to anywhere), tuning fares, comfort, and advertising as you go.

Every traveler arrives with a name, a seat, and somewhere to be. Plenty of them bring a story along too! A birthday trip, an overbooked flight, a passenger with a favor to ask: each one puts a choice in your hands, and how you respond is up to you. Sort the baggage before it piles up, get the meals out while they’re hot, get every drink onto the right tray, check boarding passes against the board, hold the plane level through turbulence and run a round of trivia at thirty thousand feet. Each mini-game is quick to pick up, and how you handle them decides who steps off smiling and where your star rating lands.

Waiting for a flight should not be the worst part of the trip. Your lounge starts as a bare hall and fills up exactly as you choose: comfy couches, an indoor garden, a coffee bar, a bookshop, a water fountain, an art gallery, a kids' corner, a live music stage. Drag each piece where you want it. Every addition nudges passenger happiness up, and turns a room people endure into one they are glad to sit in.

Every member of your cabin crew brings their own strengths across service, languages, cooking and efficiency, and putting the right person on the right route is half the job. Between flights, send them to the Break Room to sharpen up. Set the standard for catering, customer service and maintenance, and before long a handful of strangers starts to feel like a crew.

Open a route to a new city, and the Captain snaps a photo, which goes straight into your Collection Gallery, a shelf of postcards from everywhere you fly. Alongside it sits a Bestiary of sky critters to spot from the cockpit, a milestone ladder running from your very first route up to serving every city at five stars, and goals waiting on the Captain's Board.

At the end of each month, Sky writes up how it went and hands over a prize reel! Spin it with your Lucky Tickets for extra cash (sometimes a jackpot), new lounge furniture, or crew training.

Reinvest into bigger aircraft, open a second hub and then a third, and push your network out until it wraps the map. Rival airlines grow alongside you and compete for travelers on your routes, so win them back with better service, fair fares and loyal regulars. Or leave them to it, keep six routes running beautifully, and call that a career. Build the coziest airline in the skies. ✈️

The vault is a mess. Banknotes and coins from eight different currencies are scattered everywhere, and each safe-deposit box has its own specific request. Pick up, count, sort, and place every piece of money into the correct box until all 34 are complete.

With over 30,000+ banknotes waiting to be organized, there is plenty of financial chaos to clean up. Work at your own pace and use a variety of practical tools to bring the chaos under control.

SORT 8 DIFFERENT CURRENCIES

Organize banknotes and coins from USD, EUR, TRY, GBP, JPY, KRW, CNY, and RUB.

ATTRACT COINS WITH THE MAGNET

Pull scattered coins toward you and quickly collect pieces spread across the vault.

MOVE CASH WITH THE BLOWER

Use the blower to push loose money across the floor and gather it into manageable piles.

COUNT EVERY STACK

Keep track of how much money you have collected and make sure each box receives exactly what it needs.

There is no timer and no furious bank manager breathing down your neck. Just you, a mountain of cash, and the oddly satisfying task of putting every last coin where it belongs. Grab your tools, take your time, and make the vault look like someone actually works here.

Make it Beautiful, Make it Work

I grew up on SimCity and fell for Dorfromantik as an adult. Cozy Burg is my try at the best of both: a cozy hex city builder that's real underneath. You get a hand of three cards, a land card, a zone card and a road card, and you place them. Grass, forests, lakes, farms. Homes, shops and places to work. Anyone can pick it up in a minute. But nobody moves in just because you built a house. You have to earn every resident.

🏡 Real people, real jobs

Everyone in your town needs a home they like and a job they can get to, and they're picky about both. Build homes with no work in reach and they sit empty. Put the shops, offices and farms where people can get to them, and the town starts to fill. Every car you see is somebody going to work, to the shops, or home again.

🌳 Nature brings them in

People want to live somewhere nice. Homes near forests, lakes and parks fill faster and hold more people and jobs. Keep nature all around, or the people won't come.

🚦 Nobody likes a jam

Build a bad junction and traffic backs up through your streets, and jammed streets make people unhappy. The traffic lens tints every road green, amber or red so you can find the problem. Then fix it: upgrade the road, cut a second route, or draw a bus line stop by stop and watch riders climb aboard. Ferries carry cars where your roads can't reach.

🎣 Try their jobs yourself

Some of your townsfolk have jobs you can play. Drive a taxi around town, take a boat out fishing, or fly a plane and photograph landmarks. These games are optional, and if you do well they pay out cards.

🏰 A town worth visiting

Landmarks unlock from what you build. A big lake on the shore unlocks the lighthouse. A big mountain range unlocks a ski resort with a working chairlift. A level 3 road plus a running bus line unlocks the stadium, and it fills up on match day. 500 residents unlocks the airport. There's also a castle, a national park and a volcano. You unlock terrain styles for grass, forest, water and mountain, and you can repaint one tile or a whole valley.

⏳ Your pace, your cards

No energy and no timer on the building. The speed dial runs from paused to 16x. The pressure is the cards in your hand. Every town level has a goal and a budget of cards to reach it. You can redraw a bad hand for free a few times, after that a redraw costs a card. Run out before the goal and the run ends. On Gentle you always get another go, on Standard you get one, on Demanding you don't.

✨ And the small things

  • A Creative mode with everything unlocked from the first click.
  • Town services when you need them: police, fire, a hospital.
  • A narrator for the big moments.
  • A Town Film that replays your town growing, from the first tile to now.
  • A Journey mode: a tutorial and five small levels, each about one idea.
  • Give each town save a name so you can find it later.
  • Animal homes for wild horses, sheep, a bear, sea turtles and hawks. Farm hands at harvest. Gulls over the harbour. Undo, obviously.
  • The soundtrack is composed live by the game while you play. Nothing sampled, no loops.
  • Bridges that carry your roads out over open water, a drawbridge, and a taxi stand.

I'm a solo dev and this is my first game. If Cozy Burg looks like your kind of place, a wishlist honestly helps more than you know.

Early Access planned for Q4 2026.

TURN A QUIET PATCH OF LAND INTO A COZY FARM

Begin with a few planting beds, some basic tools, and plenty of room to grow.

Buy seeds, plant each crop by hand, care for your fields, and harvest at the right moment. Sell your produce for a profit, invest your earnings, and gradually transform your small plot into the farm of your dreams.

PLANT, GROW, AND HARVEST

Choose from a wide variety of crops and guide them through every stage of growth.

Prepare the soil, plant your seeds, care for each crop, and harvest your produce when it is ready. Sell what you grow and use the profits to buy new seeds, equipment, and upgrades.

DISCOVER VALUABLE MUTATIONS

Not every crop grows the same way.

Plants can reach different sizes or develop rare and valuable mutations caused by rain, frost, and lightning. Watch the weather carefully and create the right conditions to produce extraordinary harvests.

MASTER THE WEATHER

Changing weather can help your farm - or put your crops at risk.

Use specialized tools to accelerate growth, increase the chance of valuable mutations, or protect your plants from dangerous conditions. Prepare carefully and turn unpredictable weather to your advantage.

RAISE FARM ANIMALS

Bring chickens and cows to your farm and care for them to produce a steady supply of useful resources.

Collect eggs, milk, and other products that support your growing business and provide new sources of income.

HATCH AND EVOLVE PETS

Hatch helpful pets that provide special bonuses around the farm.

Feed them, help them grow, and complete their unique requirements to unlock stronger evolved forms with even better abilities.

EXPAND AND IMPROVE YOUR FARM

Unlock additional land, create more planting space, and upgrade your equipment to increase production.

Plan each investment, improve your daily routine, and make your farm more efficient with every new season of growth.

FARM AT YOUR OWN PACE

There is no fixed endpoint and no need to rush.

Enjoy a relaxing first-person farming experience with a full day-and-night cycle, changing weather, multiple crop types, useful animals, evolving pets, and plenty of upgrades to discover.

KEY FEATURES

  • Plant, grow, harvest, and sell a wide variety of crops.

  • Discover rare crop sizes and valuable weather-based mutations.

  • React to rain, frost, lightning, and other changing conditions.

  • Use specialized tools and equipment to improve production.

  • Raise chickens and cows to collect eggs, milk, and other resources.

  • Hatch, feed, grow, and evolve helpful pets.

  • Expand your land and unlock additional planting space.

  • Manage your inventory, shops, time, and farm progression.

  • Experience a full day-and-night cycle and dynamic weather.

  • Build and improve your farm without a fixed endpoint.

Cozy Necromancy is a gentle mystery about a village that cannot let go of its dead.

You are a journeyman necromancer, freshly graduated and posted to Willowmere on your first assignment. The spirit waypoint beneath the village, the Moonwell, was sealed thirty-five years ago, and the dead have been collecting behind it ever since. None of them are hostile. All of them are stuck.

There is no combat in this game. You cannot fight a ghost into peace.

Listen first

Every bound spirit is a person with an unfinished sentence: a twin who blames herself for a fire, a knight who kept the wrong oath, a hedge witch the village burned and later thanked. You travel with them, watch what they react to, read the archive someone misfiled, and ask the living about the things they would rather not say.

The ritual is an argument

When you think you know what binds a spirit, you say it with objects: three items placed in the ritual circle. What matters is what they mean... a locket, a scorched hinge, a letter never sent. Get it right and they can move on. Get it half right and they will tell you so. Nothing is ever consumed, so you can always try again.

A village that feels alive

Seven villagers with their own routines, their own gossip and their own reasons to be somewhere in the afternoon — and a square full of neighbors talking among themselves.

Six spirits and one sealed well

Six companion stories, each one resolvable on its own, and one older question underneath them all: who sealed the Moonwell, and what were they protecting?

Quiet by design

No timers, no fail states, no combat, no resource management. Packing puzzles when you want them. Hints when you are stuck, and a journal that remembers what you have worked out.

Talk to people, not to a server

The villagers' small talk, and the oracle's riddles when a ritual goes wrong, are written on the spot by a small language model that runs entirely on your computer. The model ships inside the game. The story itself is written by hand: the model is trusted with the weather, not the plot.

Fair and quiet about it

  • No ads, no microtransactions, no account.

  • Plays fully offline. Nothing about you is collected by us.

  • Keyboard and mouse.

The diner closed at dawn. The register is empty, the envelopes keep coming, and the only thing left in the drawer is Grandma's wooden spoon. Then the first egg hopped onto the counter.

Aim. Crack. Cash in.

Point at the counter and your kitchen tool swings on its own. Line up the crowd, catch as many eggs as you can in one swing, and watch shells split and coins spill. Every run lasts until your arm gives out, so make every swing count.

18 very different eggs

Lazy boiled eggs that give you a second wind, soldier eggs that fire shell shards, raptor eggs that charge into the crowd, rotten eggs that leave a gas cloud behind and a sneaky marten that steals your coins. Every egg type levels up the more you crack it.

Pay up or pack up

A new bill lands on the desk every couple of days. Pay it in full, chip away at it, or pay early for a bonus. Let one go too late and the foreclosure papers come out. Every paid bill lets you pick a recipe card that bends the rules of your next runs.

Build your breakfast engine

Spend your cash on a huge skill board: harder hits, sharp hits, longer runs, more eggs, and chain effects like salt showers, domino cracks and a helping sous chef. When things get desperate, Uncle Hamdi the rooster is only a walkie-talkie call away. His loans are fast. His cut is not small.

Features

  • Short, punchy runs (15-120 seconds) with an auto-swinging kitchen tool: you aim, it cracks
  • 18 egg types with their own behaviour and levels
  • 20 bills to pay, with late fees, early-payment bonuses and foreclosure
  • A 200+ node skill board and 67 recipe cards to draft
  • Loans from Uncle Hamdi, charms that survive foreclosure, and a final bill you will not forget
  • Seven kitchen tools, from Grandma's wooden spoon to the golden ladle
  • Warm, handmade 3D kitchen full of cartoon eggs

🛠️ Build. Experiment. Watch. Repeat.

Build crazy marble runs by combining tracks, interactive gadgets, and logic-driven contraptions.

Don't just watch marbles roll, grab them, launch them, duplicate them and build ridiculously over-engineered machines to see what happens when chaos takes over!

🎨 Create Spectacular Machines

Snap together splitters, teleporters, traps, and gadgets to create anything from soothing ASMR runs to terrifying obstacle courses. Add logic gates to automate the madness. If a marble is blue, send it left. If it is tiny, make it huge. If it is last, smash it with a giant hammer!

🥊 The World is Your Toy Box

Drop into massive interactive parks packed with ramps, magnets, fans, and destructible obstacles. Grab a marble and throw it. Slingshot it through a hoop. Freeze it, blast it, or spawn a hundred at once to see what breaks first.

⚡Logic-Driven Chain Reactions

Marbles do not have to only obey normal physics. Give them custom behaviors and watch bizarre ecosystems emerge. Make blue marbles chase red ones. Make them orbit each other, repel, or even eat one another! 

🏁 Host Crazy Races

Release thousands of custom marbles into chaotic tracks filled with crushers, fans, and traps. Customize their colors, and see who survives the gauntlet.

🌐 Infinite Sandbox, Steam Workshop & Remixes

Upload your finest machines or most disastrous experiments to the Steam Workshop. Download creations from other players, figure out how they work, and then completely dismantle them to add your own chaotic spin.

🚀 What Will You Invent?

  • A crazy racing circuit running at max speed?

  • An infinite loop of duplicating and shattering marbles?

  • A perfectly synchronized sorting factory?

    Start small. Make it crazy. And share it with the community!

Cranked is the dream project of a small team of riders and developers, including members of the original crew behind Mad Skills Motocross and Mad Skills BMX. It’s a downhill mountain bike game built to capture what it really feels like to ride—the speed, the flow, and the satisfaction of control—paired with the obsessive pursuit of the perfect run.

What Makes Cranked Different

Fun-First Design

Every choice is guided by a single question: does it make the game more fun? We're going back to old-school game design where our priority is the player experience. No microtransactions. No exploitative hooks. Just pure MTB fun. 

Responsive Control

The “free-whip” system gives you full command of bike handling and style, with no canned animations getting in the way. Cranked has a heavy focus on technical riding, line choice, and capturing the essence of real-world trails. 

Global Racing Competition

Push yourself against players worldwide on constantly updated leaderboards, with instant restarts that fuel mastery and the hunt for that perfect run.

Open-Mountain Freedom

Explore a vast landscape of trails, hidden paths, shortcuts, and easter eggs at your own pace.

Modding as a Pillar

Modding isn’t an extra feature; it’s a non-negotiable pillar of Cranked’s design.

You build it. Then you have to drive it.

CrashFest is an arcade racer that never hands you a circuit. You snap one together out of hairpins, ramps, helixes and holes — and then the whole field races it for points, everybody bolts on one more piece, and you race it again.

By round five the track is three times the length, four people have left mines on it, and that lovely chicane you were so pleased with is the exact reason you are last.

No level select. No track designers. Just whatever six drivers thought was a good idea at the time.

Everyone gets a turn with the track

  • 27 snap-together pieces — hairpins, sweepers, chicanes, banked curves, ramps, four helixes, and five with holes straight through the road

  • One piece per racer, per round, handed out in finishing order

  • The bots build too. They pick at random, which is exactly as dangerous as it sounds

  • Start from nothing if you like — an empty grid and a field laying the first circuit together

  • Save a track you are proud of and bring it back another night

Racing, with the gloves off

  • Seven power-ups — shotgun, landmine, barrier, tyre stack, tow line, shield and a homing missile that picks its own target

  • A wreck is not the end of your round. You wait at the next gate as a ghost and rejoin the moment a survivor reaches it

  • Get left behind far enough that the camera cannot hold you and you are gone. Keep up

  • Dropped hazards are permanent. Mines and barriers outlive the round, so by round four the track is visibly a place where four races have already happened

  • Armco down both edges — or switch it off, and a mistake costs you the race instead of a tenth

Three ways to play with no track at all

  • SUMO — six cars on a rooftop with no parapet and a hole in the middle. Last one still up there wins

  • BOMB TAG — walled roof, one bomb, one fuse. Touch somebody to hand it on. The fuse does not reset

  • TURF — the floor is carved into a slice each and there is one ball. Every second it sits in your slice, you score. Nobody is ever eliminated

On one screen, on one sofa

  • Six cars on the grid — friends and bots come out of the same six seats

  • Bots yield. Somebody picking up a controller is never told the race is full

  • Up to four gamepads, Xbox and PlayStation both mapped properly, with keyboard blocks for anyone left over

  • Pick your colour and your name — the lobby remembers both

  • A match runs to a points target: around a quarter of an hour, five rounds, and a track that grows the whole way through

Crawling Desktop Pet is a companion-focused creature-raising game that brings an unusual little lifeform onto your Windows desktop.

It follows your cursor, crawls freely across the screen, and reacts to toys and its surroundings. Or it can simply stay by your side while you work, study, browse, or relax.

From Egg to Desktop Companion

Tap the shell and hatch your first desktop companion.

Feed it, care for it, and watch it grow and evolve as new interactions and collectibles gradually become available. Your pet also produces Crystals that can be used to obtain food, upgrades, scenes, toys, and new companions.

Raise and Collect

Hatch different pet eggs, raise multiple companions, and switch the pet that stays with you whenever you like.

More possibilities open up as you progress. Arrange different scenes, place a variety of toys, and see how your pets react. You can also unlock achievements and personalization items to give your presence a more distinctive look.

Create a Creature of Your Own

Each pet is driven in real time by a procedural skeletal system rather than fixed, pre-rendered animations.

Adjust the proportions, structure, movement, and appearance of individual body parts to create something gentle, strange, elegant, or completely unexpected. Designs can be saved, imported, and exported, making it easy to keep experimenting or share your creations.

A Companion on Your Terms

Switch between the full window and transparent desktop modes. Hide interface elements, reduce notifications, or enable mouse click-through whenever you need a quieter desktop.

Whether you want to focus on raising and creating or simply keep a small creature resting in the corner of your screen, Crawling Desktop Pet can fit naturally into your routine.

Connect with Friends

Invite friends for online interactions, show off your pets and personalized looks, and discover more lighthearted ways to spend time together.

Every desktop pet can become a little life that is uniquely yours.

Join Our Community

Have feedback, ideas, or a creature of your own to share? Join our Discord community to meet other players, showcase your desktop pets and custom creations, report issues, and keep up with the latest updates.

Hunt birds!

Inspired by the cult classic Moorhuhn: use your cursor to hunt ducks, chickens, geese, moorhens, white swans, and black swans across a beautiful autumn landscape!

Upgrades!

Unlock new upgrades and permanently improve your hunting abilities! Slow down time, trigger chain lightning, and increase your hit radius!

Armory!

Buy new weapons—more ammo, more firepower!

Leaderboard!

Compete for the high score and challenge your friends and hunters around the world!

Overview

Crazy Life is a multiplayer, board-game-style life simulation that can be played by up to six players.

Rules

The game is turn-based, with one turn representing one in-game year.
When the game ends, the player with the highest total assets wins.
Players spin a roulette wheel to determine their movement and trigger different events depending on the space they land on.

Types of space

※This image is from the Japanese version, but the full English version will be available in the final release.
Card acquisition space

You can obtain one random card out of 60 different types.
Using the cards you’ve collected allows you to gain advantages and change the flow of the game.

Card purchase space

You can purchase selected cards

money space

Random events can increase or decrease your money.

Job change space

You can change jobs to a random occupation.
There is a chance that you will not be hired.

Promotion Space

If you already have a job, landing on this space increases your Job Level.
If you are unemployed, it has the same effect as a Card Space.

salary Space

You earn a salary based on your current job and job level.

Each time you pass a Payday Space, a “Payday” is counted.
At the end of your turn, all counted “Paydays” are consumed and your salary is paid.
If you land exactly on a Payday Space, your salary is doubled.

Marriage space (Before Marriage)

You can get married by increasing your relationship level with a character you’ve exchanged contact information with.
Characters of higher rarity have unique abilities that can give you powerful advantages during the game.

Marriage space (After Marriage)

After getting married, you can have children by landing on certain spaces.
You can also increase your child’s stats as they grow.
Children take action once every three years — they can earn money or even bring you new cards!

Worst space

You may have to pay a huge fine, lose your job, or even see your properties burn down.

Hunt. Grow stronger. End the eternal night.

Crimson Ark is a single-player dark fantasy action RPG built around loot, character growth, and spellcasting combat. Choose one of three heroines with distinct magical powers and journey alongside Maria through five regions beneath a crimson night.

  • Three heroines, three schools of magic — elemental, blood and holy

  • Loot that reshapes your build — prefixes, suffixes, set bonuses and reforging

  • Auto-hunt the fields, fight bosses yourself — evade their patterns and unleash your spells during a Break

  • An endgame after the story — Boss Challenges, the Infinite Tower, raids and more

  • English & Japanese voices — and a free demo you can play right now

[ Three Heroines, Three Ways to Fight ]

  • Serena — Elemental Magic Sweep through groups of enemies with wide-area spells and control the battlefield.

  • Lilith — Blood Magic Focus on powerful foes, using bleeding and life drain to sustain your assault.

  • Beatrice — Holy Magic Endure through protection and healing, then seize your chance to strike back.

Choose your favorite spells from three distinct mages and develop them into spectacular ultimate skills. Combine skills and talent nodes, then find the gear that brings your chosen fighting style to life.

Loot Worth Hunting For Prefixes, suffixes, and set bonuses can give the same piece of equipment a different purpose. Compare your finds, upgrade your gear, and reforge its affixes to shape your build. Collect pets and auras, ascend your Circle, and strengthen the World Tree to keep growing.

Steady Progress. Bosses to Overcome. Build up experience and loot through auto-hunting, then take direct control to find openings against formidable bosses. Evade dangerous patterns and unleash your spells during a Break to turn the fight in your favor.

When the Blood Moon rises, enemies close in from every direction. Unleash your magic and break through.

Fight alongside your companions and enjoy their playful banter, brought to life with English and Japanese voices.

Unexpected Encounters Along the Way Chase golden goblins, discover hidden treasure rooms, and accept a rival's challenge. Conversations with your companion Maria bring small moments of character to your journey between battles.

Challenges Beyond the Journey Take on higher-difficulty Boss Challenges for equipment and growth materials. In the Infinite Tower, push your limits with the blessings you earn on each floor. Beyond them await the Last Bastion, raids and the Ruin Rift.

Add Crimson Ark to your wishlist to be notified the moment it launches.

The old Monarch is dead. You bear the Crimson Seal—the mark of the Crimson Monarch, supreme ruler of the five vampire factions and protector of the Veil, the sacred pact that hides vampirism from humanity.

Choose your heir from five ruthless factions. Every decision you issue reshapes your reputation, tests your morality, and turns allies into future rivals.

Protect the Veil—or expose it and risk open war with humanity.

🩸 Choose Your Heir:

Pick your protagonist from one of five distinct vampire bloodlines, unlocking unique story paths and faction interactions.

🩸 Rule by choice:

Balance reputation across all five factions. Serve one side too closely, and the others will plot your execution.

🩸 Life-or-Death Judgment:

Decide who inherits power, who is exiled, and who is put to the stake. There are no clean moral answers—only survival.

🩸 Protect the Veil or Expose It:

Your choices decide whether vampirism remains a hidden myth or spills into open war with humanity.

The Five Vampire Factions

Dominion Aristocrats

 The late Monarch’s legacy bloodline, clinging to ancient power, wealth, and birthright.

The Syndicate 

A modern blood cartel operating through Big Pharma, controlling the corpse trade and human blood supply.

The Eclipse

Religious zealots and ritualists who wield blood magic to guard the mysteries of the Seal.

The Nocturnals

Vampire purists who reject modern society, sleep in coffins, and hunt humans in the shadows.

Bon Vivants

 Hedonists embedded in human elite culture, manipulating mortals through pleasure, art, and vice.

Critical Ward

The hospital is at its limit. So are you.

Critical Ward is a fast, addictive and 100% arcade survival experience, designed to turn every run from a seemingly manageable shift into a spectacle of absolute chaos.

Treat patients, build enormous combos, deploy automated medical equipment and create completely ridiculous builds as the hospital fills with contagious patients, disruptive relatives and events capable of destroying your strategy in seconds.

The better you play, the stronger your build becomes. The stronger it becomes, the harder it is to keep it alive.

Master the chaos

Choose from characters with radically different abilities and playstyles, including specialists in healing, speed, crowd control, technology and strategies that completely transform the rules of each run.

Learn their strengths, complete their challenges and unlock new characters and ways to play through an old-school progression system with no microtransactions or paid shortcuts.

Huge combos. Absurd builds.

Keep your streak alive, stack powerful bonuses and turn a good run into an overwhelming display of power.

Turrets, prototypes, special items, skyrocketing stats and chained effects can transform the screen into glorious chaos. But a single mistake can erase everything you have built.

Old-school arcade action

Distinctive pixel art, direct animations and a presentation inspired by classic arcade games. Every character, effect and explosion of chaos is designed to deliver an authentic old-school arcade experience.

All of it is driven by an incredible soundtrack, created to maintain the intensity and make every run immediately demand another one.

Features

  • Fast, addictive and 100% arcade survival gameplay.

  • An incredible soundtrack that drives the chaos from beginning to end.

  • A combo system capable of generating enormous bonuses.

  • Completely ridiculous builds and runs that never stop escalating.

  • Characters with entirely different abilities and playstyles.

  • Pixel art graphics with an authentic old-school arcade spirit.

  • Automated medical equipment, prototypes and special items.

  • Contagious patients, troublesome relatives and unpredictable events.

  • Achievements, challenges and unlocks inspired by classic progression systems.

  • No microtransactions: everything is earned by playing.

  • Intense runs with extremely high replayability.

The hospital never stops

Every patient you discharge makes you stronger. Every second brings new problems.

Build the perfect run, push your combo to the limit and discover how much chaos you can control before the entire hospital collapses.

◆ Welcome to Croissant Simulator!
Manage your own croissant restaurant and enjoy a relaxing kitchen experience. Take orders, prepare fresh croissants, stock up on ingredients, and serve your customers. The gameplay is designed to be simple, intuitive, and smooth.

◆ Step into the kitchen and make Croissants!
Store the ingredients you order in your cabinet and take them out when you need them. Combine your ingredients according to various croissant recipes, prepare them using unique mechanics, and your dish is ready!

◆ Keep your customers happy!
Build your popularity in the city and welcome more customers to your restaurant. Prepare each customer's order from your menu and serve it on time.

Croissant Simulator is entirely focused on the restaurant experience. Everything takes place in the kitchen and service area, putting croissant preparation and customer service at the heart of the game. Every step is clear and controlled.
As you handle the daily workload, you can make your restaurant more efficient and enjoy the satisfaction of a well-organized routine. Over time, improve your workflow and create a smoother service experience.

BET IN SECRET. LIE IN PUBLIC. RIG THE RACE.

Crooked Derby is a turn-based digital board game for 2–6 players. Play solo against bots, host a table with friends, or buy into a Derby against strangers.

Secretly bet on one of six equally matched horses, then publicly claim which horse you support.

Every card is played face-up, so you must manipulate the race without revealing where your money really is. Watch how your opponents play, question their stories, and Call the Bluff—but every accusation puts your turn and your own secret on the line.

When the race ends, every bet and lie still hidden is revealed.

Win races, expose your rivals, protect your bankroll, and finish the match with more money than anyone else.

PLACE YOUR SECRET BET

Everyone sits down with the same bankroll. Before each race, choose which horse carries your money and how much of your bankroll you are willing to risk.

Your stake is visible to everyone.

Your chosen horse remains secret until the end of the race—unless someone calls your bluff.

A larger wager wins a larger share of the pot, but it also gives your opponents more reason to study every move you make.

TELL THE TABLE YOUR STORY

After placing your bet, publicly declare which horse you claim to support. This is your Public Story.

You can tell the truth, construct a convincing lie, or choose the horse your cards give you the best chance of defending.

Telling the truth lets you play more directly, but makes your intentions easier to follow.

Lying can redirect suspicion and sabotage towards another horse, but maintaining the deception may force you to make less efficient moves.

If nobody exposes your lie, the house pays you a 1,000-coin bonus at the finish—win or lose.

MANIPULATE THE RACE

Once the gates open, every card is played face-up, and every turn is on the clock.

Push a horse forward, drag the leader back, rescue a long shot, or prepare a late-race reversal.

Your cards will not always favour your secret horse. Sometimes the strongest move for the race is the worst move for your story. Sometimes helping the wrong horse is exactly what keeps your real bet hidden.

Every action becomes evidence.

Are your opponents protecting their money, supporting their Public Story, building an alibi—or trying to bait you?

CALL THEIR BLUFF

Watch how your rivals play and compare their actions with the stories they told.

At the start of your turn, you can Call the Bluff on another player's story. You get one call per race, and the verdict is instant.

Call it right and the house pays you a 500-coin bounty, the liar's real horse is exposed to the whole table, and you take their next turn.

Call it wrong and your own horse is exposed, their story is certified true, and they play your turn instead.

No money changes hands between players. What you risk is your turn and your secret.

The cards are visible.

The intentions are not.

WIN THE RACE BEHIND THE RACE

When a horse crosses the finish line, every secret bet still hidden is revealed.

Players who backed the winner split the pot in proportion to their stakes, plus a house bonus. If nobody backed the winner, the whole pot rolls over into the next race as a growing jackpot. Every lie that got away with it collects its bonus.

Then the table resets.

New bets. New stories. New opportunities to deceive—or be deceived.

One race can make you rich. One reckless wager can knock you out: run out of money and you're eliminated.

Finish the match with the largest bankroll to win.

CHOOSE YOUR TABLE

  • Tutorial — a short guided race that teaches the crooked trade.

  • Solo — set your own table: 1 to 5 bots at Easy, Medium or Hard, over 1 to 5 races.

  • Multiplayer — host or join a table with friends over Steam or LAN. Free to sit.

  • Derbys — pay the entry in Stubs, earned free every day, race strangers, and the winner takes the purse. Climb four venues, from the County Fairgrounds to the Back Lot, the Night Track and the Vault, each with its own world, crowd and sound.

In Solo and Multiplayer, pick your distance—a short Sprint or a Full Lap—and your deck. The Classic deck plays it straight. The Crooked deck mixes in dirty plays that move two horses at once, doping, and a hidden track trap: everyone sees that a trap was set, but nobody knows where.

KEY FEATURES

  • Secret bets, public stakes — everyone sees how much you risk, but not which horse carries your money.

  • Public Stories — tell the truth, construct a believable lie, or claim the horse your hand can best defend. A lie nobody exposes pays a bonus.

  • Face-up card manipulation — every move changes the race and reveals something about the player behind it.

  • Bluff Calls with real consequences — call it right to win a bounty and steal the liar's turn; call it wrong and you expose yourself.

  • Six equally matched horses — favourites and long shots emerge entirely from the players' decisions.

  • Bankroll management — decide when to play cautiously and when to risk everything. Go broke and you're out.

  • Rollover jackpots — when nobody backs the winner, the pot carries into the next race.

  • Derbys — buy into four venues against strangers, winner takes the purse.

  • Sprint or Full Lap, Classic or Crooked deck — set the race to suit your table.

  • Stickers and quick-chat taunts — needle your rivals without typing a word.

  • Solo, friends and online play — compete against bots at three difficulties or face other players online.

  • Matches for 2–6 players — every additional player introduces more stories, motives, and opportunities for deception.

  • Compact multi-race matches built around tension, misdirection, and sudden reversals.

Weave words and cross them for massive combos!
This is a competitive crossword puzzle game where you freely move letter blocks to create words,
crossing them to build massive chain reactions!

■ Intuitive Puzzles at Your Own Pace

There are no falling blocks to rush you like in traditional puzzle games.
With a generous time limit, you can freely move, rotate, and place blocks.
Create words of 3 or more letters, branch off them to build a crossword, and set up huge combos.

Thanks to balanced block generation and a time-triggered "Hint" feature, anyone can easily experience the exhilaration of massive chain reactions.

Prologue: A Deck in the Flames

The old king and the enemy monarch recognized each other on the battlefield—twenty years ago, they were young comrades-in-arms fighting side by side while fleeing for their lives.

"Klenz," said the old king, "look at what I've brought you."

"A deck, and a war."

War broke out between the two kingdoms, and those who fell were the strength of the nations and the beloved of their people. So they made a pact: to replace actual war with a card game.

However, the pact of peace was betrayed. The old king was ambushed by fire on his way back to the city, falling in a pool of blood; while the enemy monarch was struck down by divine judgment on his own journey home. The two nations became mortal enemies. The cards that symbolized peace, and the secrets of the two kings, all turned to ashes.

Years later, you become the heir of one of the six kingdoms, taking your seat at the council table to attend the annual Alliance Peace Conference. Six nations vie for the Crown at the conference, and the card game has become the battlefield.

In the world of Crown's Gambit, the six kingdoms hold a council each year to battle for the crown symbolizing supreme royal authority. War is forbidden during the council; instead, card battles take its place.

Core Gameplay: The Six Kingdoms' War at the Council Table

Six monarchs are divided into two federations, engaging in a 3v3 federal duel. Your seat at the table determines your fate:

  • Sitting directly opposite you is your Arch-Rival. Stop them at all costs. If they fail to escort the Queen back to the city (fail to Open) or fail to be the first to finish their cards and claim the crown, they become vassals of your kingdom and must pay tribute to you at the next council to redeem their captured Queen. (Tribute requires a certain number of high cards; Papal/Bishop cards are not included in tribute.)

  • To your left and right are the Pact Nations, with whom you have signed a peace treaty. They are opponents, but you cannot attack their Royal Knights during the council. Attacking the Knights of a Pact Nation or an Ally will invoke God's Punishment (it is said that King Klenz died from divine judgment after breaking his pact). If you break the pact, you must play the Bishop cards (the Jokers) to avoid divine judgment, or you will become a vassal of the enemy nation. But if you successfully break the pact and claim the crown, you will capture the opposing Queen and force them to pay tribute to redeem her at the next council.

  • Across the table, one seat removed, are your Allies. They will help you claim the crown. Of course, attacking an Ally's Royal Knights will also invoke divine punishment.

【Core Card Types】

  • The Royal Knights are your trump cards: formed by combinations like five 10s, four Jacks, three Queens, or two Kings. Only Knight members can escort the Queen.

  • Your Queen (Small 4): Must be escorted back by the Royal Knights. If you fail, the Queen is captured, and you must pay tribute to redeem her next year.

  • Your King (Single 3): Must be played as your very last card, safely reaching the finish line. If trapped by the opponent, the entire alliance becomes passive.

  • Commoners (5-9): Basic card types, where quantity determines their strength.

【Three Phases of Battle】

  • Act I (The Prelude): The Queen is on her way to the council, and even the Royal Knights cannot escort her back to the capital yet.

  • Act II (The Council): You can now escort the Queen, and attacking the Royal Knights of non-enemy nations will invoke divine judgment.

  • Act III (The Mêlée): Unlocks when only 4 or fewer nations remain. Escorting the Queen is no longer allowed, and divine judgment is suspended. Fight to your heart's content to claim the final Crown!

【Coronation Moment & Systems】

  • Card Announcement: When a player's hand drops to 10 cards or fewer, they must publicly reveal the remaining count. From this moment on, you become the focus of the whole table—your allies will support you with all their might to push for the throne, while your opponents will do everything in their power to stop you.

  • Federal Scoring: Points are calculated for the alliance as a whole each round; the honor belongs to the federation. Even if the federation fails, individuals who perform exceptionally well can still earn high points—honor is not limited to victory.

  • Customization: Each nation features unique backgrounds, emotes, and monarch skins. Define your kingdom your way.

  • Six Factions: Each monarch has a unique backstory and initial inclinations—which faction will you represent?

How long can your honor defend the throne?

“Unite your allies, seize the crown.”

Crown's Gambit is more than just a poker game; it is a narrative of trust, betrayal, and honor. Every card is either a stepping stone to the throne or a trap leading into the abyss.
